summary: Umatilla NF pole L-5 lookout in Morrow County, staffed 1934-1943, removed or destroyed in 1957; no source describes the site today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Heppner Gazette-Times item dated November 12, 1931 says a tree tower was erected at Red Hill. Firelookout.com dates the 24-foot pole L-5 tower to 1933 and the FFLOS register to 1936. The story gives the newspaper date and the two later dates as each source states them, without choosing one.

FFLOS says the tower was removed in 1957, and firelookout.com says it was destroyed that year. The Oregon Lookouts page quotes a January 1958 annual report that records a removal. The story reports all three.

notes_for_editor: Three pages, all describing the same 24-foot pole L-5 tower, but they disagree on the build date (1931 newspaper item, 1933 firelookout.com, 1936 FFLOS) and on removal versus destruction (1957). The Oregon Lookouts page quotes a January 1958 annual report, so the removal may be dated to 1957 or 1958; the story does not pick one. The FFLOS page gives its 1953 photo caption with no image URL captured, so no photos are listed. Do not confuse this record with the separate Red Hill lookout on firelookout.com (/or/redhill.html) and the NHLR (nhlr.org/lookouts/us/or/red-hill-lookout/), which describes a 1917 site and a 40-foot L-4 tower built in 1947 or 1949 that still stands; that is a different site and was not checked against this one. Height 7.3 m is the conversion of the 24-foot pole height given by FFLOS and firelookout.com. The 1946 NGS survey note is historical; it is not evidence about the site today. The NGS station description quoted on Oregon Lookouts places the site about 14 miles northeast of Monument, while firelookout.com says north; the story attributes 'north' to firelookout.com only.
